Docs/Parallel environments

Parallel environments

Scale evaluation by independent processes while preserving the single-environment native-scene contract.

One scene evaluator per process

The native-scene factory enforces one CPU-physics environment. It restores the registered robot, horizon, controller and camera profile and rejects incompatible overrides. The GR00T evaluation loop also requires num_eval_envs == 1.

Do not increase num_envs for this track

Run separate processes for tasks, backgrounds or seed shards. Generic ManiSkill GPU-vectorized training capabilities do not imply vectorized support in this DexArena evaluation factory.

Plan and inspect the 90-scene matrix

python utils/scene_matrix.py plan --out output/scene90
python utils/scene_matrix.py preview --index 2 --out output/scene90/preview
python utils/scene_matrix.py preview \
  --out output/scene90/preview --shard 0 --shards 3 --resume

The planner and previews check scene construction, not policy success. For policy sweeps, assign disjoint task/scene/seed tuples to workers, use separate output directories, and merge per-episode records only after checking duplicates and missing episodes.

Record the same checkpoint, adapter, task revision and camera configuration for every shard. Aggregate by task rather than by worker so uneven shard sizes cannot change the score.
